facility_fee: Official room source and booking Hotel Alerts state no facility/resort fee. This does not remove displayed taxes or establish every possible extra.
guarantee: Credit-card guarantee required; deposit/hold amount and payment timing are not established. No card or reservation supplied.

learning.family_decision: Can the named suite budget and hotel-return rest plan be evaluated without mistaking search output for confirmed occupancy or quiet conditions?
learning.hypothesis: The retained historical studio range and generic larger-suite description cover the five-person budget/rest decision.
learning.result: REJECT. Implement the dated named-suite sample and newly observed weekday renovation notice with unresolved bed/party limits. Neither a returned price nor published bed count proves acceptance.
learning.confidence: High observed amounts, input ages and published notice/conflict; limited actual occupancy acceptance, affected dates/floors, noise and additional-charge completeness.
learning.reusable_lesson: Exact ages entered are stronger input evidence than counts, but contradictory returned room capacity still blocks acceptance claims. A weekday work notice is a rest-planning constraint without being a guaranteed noise report.
learning.next_falsification_trigger: Changed official renovation/bed/party/policy evidence or actual property clarification. Reprice and confirm selected category/party/rest constraints before booking; no unchanged denied-source retry.
